trigger.scope: P0 decomposition of current business processes

rationale: Create a shared helper for dated/topic policy updates that had been duplicated across product discovery, discount, 3DS recovery, and date/time. The helper owns bounded scanning, date-as-scope semantics, topic-folder sibling updates, and literal override scope.

dependencies.why: Defines the trusted date/timestamp provider for operating-day and lockout comparisons.

rollback.strategy: Route dated-update logic back into the domain BPs if the shared helper over-triggers or hides domain-specific gates.

retired_reason: post-world-refresh clean competition: prevent resolver fallback to stale historical BP versions while keeping version files in place for future PA-fix history
